kerr_gain_countermodel.equation: theta_i = k_i * m_i; instrument common gain could be factored into k_i
kerr_gain_countermodel.interpretation: Unknown material-dependent optical coefficient prevents treating maximum Kerr as maximum saturation magnetization. Models are algebraic witnesses; physical realizability of particular gains has not been measured.
kerr_gain_countermodel.resolving_interface: Specimen-specific magneto-optical coefficient or independent calibrated VSM/SQUID magnetometry at the chosen geometry and temperature.

preparation_transfer_countermodel.available_preparation_support: single prepared source library; no treatment index or repeated preparation is in acquired data
preparation_transfer_countermodel.unobserved_preparation_difference: At p=1, arbitrary nonzero psi can change the optimum while preserving every observed value at p=0.
preparation_transfer_countermodel.smoothness: For finitely many distinct compositions, disjoint smooth bump functions can specify arbitrary finite psi values. Smoothness alone does not resolve the ambiguity.
preparation_transfer_countermodel.qualification: This is an unrestricted-model identifiability statement, not proof that every psi is physically realizable. A physical structural sufficiency law could exclude it, but such a law is not independently validated by these data.
preparation_transfer_countermodel.resolving_interface: Repeated matched compositions under independently varied preparation, co-registered XRD and raw magnetic loops, with blinded refabrication and an equally informed baseline.
